operations.evidence: The detailed continuation contract, canonical branch HEAD 2992228279f27da21cf16d4cea67d6291ba83ed4 and existing continuation key were read before writes.
Ownership was UNCLAIMED; a 15-minute lease was claimed only for official-source and line-by-line web evidence. Runner and business writes remained disabled.

Official files for domain ranks, scores, deciles, denominators, indicators and transformed scores were classified by role so incompatible fields are not silently substituted.
IoD25 ranks were confirmed as relative ordering; rank 100 is not interpreted as twice the deprivation or risk of rank 200.
The Crime Domain measures relative risk of personal and material victimisation at LSOA level and is not represented as an exact parcel crime probability or cardinal safety score.
The official FAQ describes joining ONS postcode lookup data to IoD25 by LSOA; this is retained as lookup guidance and not substituted for exact parcel point-in-polygon evidence.
ONS confirms that Census 2021 changed some 2011 LSOAs through splits or merges; 2011 and 2021 geometries or codes cannot be mixed.
ONS reports 33,755 England LSOAs with 1,000-3,000 residents and supplies official 2021 boundaries, names, codes and lookup files through Open Geography.
Police.uk monthly force extracts, format checks, automated tests and force approval were recorded as source-quality evidence without upgrading parcel attribution confidence.
The Police.uk LSOA field refers to the LSOA containing the anonymised map point; it is not treated as proof that an exact incident or target parcel lies at that point.
Published coordinates were confirmed as privacy-protecting snap points rather than exact incident coordinates, including address-count rules and zeroing when no nearby point exists.
Police.uk reports force geocoding accuracy estimates from 60 to 97 percent; no 95-percent parcel confidence is inferred from street-level coordinates alone.
Police records may later be reclassified or relocated and fixes are tracked through monthly publications and the changelog; month and source snapshot remain pinned.
